Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_PhysicalLoadScal: Scales how much worn gear slows endurance recovery and makes exertion cost more. 1.0 is the default, 0 turns the weight effect off, 2.0 doubles it.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableThermalMod: When enabled, insulating gear that traps body heat slows endurance recovery and makes exertion cost more while you are running hot.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableBreathingM: When enabled, gas masks, respirators and sealed suits make running and sprinting cost more endurance.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableMuscleStra: When enabled, heavy gear on the shoulders, arms and hands adds extra vanilla melee muscle strain during combat.
Sandbox_ArmorMakesSense_EnableSleepPenal: When enabled, sleeping in stiff gear such as armor and pads slows how fast sleep clears fatigue.
